title: Skill eval executor
description: Runs a skillgrade eval suite for an agent skill, with the skill installed and without it, and writes a benchmark comparing the two. The suite folder holds eval.base.yaml (skillgrade defaults and graders), tasks/*.yaml (one task per file), and optionally footer.md, prepare.ts, and solutions/<task>.sh.

skill.description: Skill folder (relative to the workspace root) installed in the with-skill variant.

evalsDir.description: Eval suite folder (relative to the workspace root).

agent.description: Coding-agent CLI the suite's agent command runs.

model.description: Model passed to the agent CLI. Omit to use the CLI default.

variants.description: Runs to compare: with-skill installs the skill in the workspace, baseline does not.

parallel.description: Trials run at once. Keep at 1 for CLI agents unless the machine has headroom.

timeout.description: Agent time limit per trial, in seconds.

eval.description: Task names to run. Omit to run every task.

filter.description: skillgrade metadata filters (KEY=VALUE), e.g. tags=smoke. Repeated keys AND together.

grader.description: Graders to run. auto runs the LLM rubric only when a grader API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY) is set.

graderProvider.description: LLM rubric provider. Defaults to the first provider with an API key set.

graderModel.description: LLM rubric model. Omit to use skillgrade's default for the provider.

threshold.description: Fail when the with-skill mean reward is below this value.

validate.description: Check the graders instead of an agent: run solutions/<task>.sh for each task that has one, and fail unless every solution scores 1.0 on the deterministic graders.

list.description: List the selected tasks and exit.

preview.description: Show saved results instead of running: `cli` prints every variant, `browser` serves the first variant in `variants`.

iteration.description: Iteration to preview. Defaults to the latest in outputPath.

outputPath.description: Results folder (relative to the workspace root). Each run writes a new iteration-N folder.
